name: PennyCompute buyer API
description: Media jobs over HTTP: video generation with MiniMax H3, FFmpeg work (transcode, stitch, sound mix, captions, timeline exports, frame images and sound files), media measurement and Remotion renders. Create a server API key in the dashboard at https://app.pennycompute.com and send it on every call as Authorization: Bearer <key>. Submit a job to POST /v1/jobs with a service_id and its input, read GET /v1/jobs/{id} until its status is final or register a webhook endpoint, then fetch the file from the link GET /v1/jobs/{id}/output returns. Media goes in by public link; POST /v1/assets hosts one source file or a complete Remotion bundle. h3.video.v1 is text to video with optional first and last frames or reference files; h3.reference_480p.v1 is the earlier one-image preset, kept for existing integrations. Bodies are JSON, up to 2 MB. Amounts are strings in millionths of one US dollar. Each API key may send 600 requests a minute. A request over the limit receives HTTP 429 with the error rate_limited and a Retry-After header in seconds. Job submissions, estimates and capacity reads are each limited to 120 a minute for a key and answer 429 past that. Guides are at https://pennycompute.com/docs, the reference at https://pennycompute.com/docs/api and the dated list of changes at https://pennycompute.com/docs/changes.
